title: Run backend test suite
task: Execute: cd backend && npm test. Capture results, open issues for any failures with stack traces attached.

title: Validate Ed25519 signatures
task: Run ed25519.test.ts and verify all 20+ tests pass. Attach test output and coverage report.

title: Test circuit breaker behavior
task: Simulate ACA-Py failures and verify circuit breaker opens after 5 failures. Record state transitions.

title: Run Merkle anchoring smoke test
task: Create batch of 100 events, verify Merkle root generation and proof validation. Measure performance.

title: Test ClaimWizard e2e flow
task: Automate: enter NPI → upload files → submit → verify status updates. Screenshot each step.

title: Test SLO Dashboard
task: Navigate to /dashboard/slo, verify metrics load, charts render, and alerts show correctly.

title: Health check validation
task: Call /api/health and verify all subchecks (Redis, DB, Prometheus) return healthy status.

title: Test issuer portal
task: Navigate to /issuer/issue, search NPI, select template, submit issuance. Verify request succeeds.

title: OIDC4VCI compliance check
task: Validate /.well-known/openid-credential-issuer against OIDC4VCI spec. Generate compliance report.

title: Build and verify Docker images
task: Build backend/frontend Docker images, run containers, verify health checks pass.
